title: Brian Boroimhe house
html_source: Just north of the Crossguns bridge, at 1 Prospect Terrace, the funeral carriages pass a pub called the “Brian Boroimhe house,” named after the great Irish leader Brian Boru (Boroimhe), who reigned as High King from 1002 and whose army defeated the Danes at Clontarf in 1014
